title: Client fishes for rate and approval, rep slips on both
scenario: Alex, a nurse buying her first home with a modest down payment, keeps pressing for a specific rate and whether she'll be approved. The rep caves on both.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi Alex, Shawn with Copperleaf Home Loans. Thanks for calling back.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Hi, yeah, sorry, I just got off a twelve-hour shift.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Oh wow, where do you work?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I'm a nurse at the regional hospital. ICU.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's intense. Thank you for doing that.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Ha, thanks. Okay so I've been looking at houses around three hundred thousand. I've got maybe five percent down.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Great, that's a very doable starting point for a lot of buyers.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: So what kind of rate would I get with that?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: With five down and a nurse's income, you're probably looking at about six and a quarter.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. And my credit's like six-eighty, is that going to be a problem? Will I get approved?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Six-eighty with your job? Oh, you're approved, don't even worry about it.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Seriously? That's way easier than I thought.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Yeah, nurses are great borrowers. Stable job.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: So what's the next step, do I fill something out?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Yep, I'll send you the application. Pay stubs, W-2s and bank statements.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. I work nights so I'll do it on my day off.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Works for me. Would Wednesday or Thursday be better for a follow-up?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Thursday.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Thursday then. Get some sleep, Alex.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Ha, I'll try. Bye.
